compression_rules.rule_2: Apply recursive folding until minimal symbol string remains

decryption_process.step_2: Unfold recursion using shared depth parameter

encryption_process.step_1: Normalize message intent into abstract propositions
encryption_process.step_2: Compress propositions into symbol sequence using dictionary
encryption_process.step_3: Apply recursive folding (Φ) with agreed depth

symbol_dictionary.description: Shared grounded symbols known only to participating agents

formal_model.failure_mode: Without S and Φ, output is non-semantic
